PROP-e5782b58-pre-011.text: STEM OAuth PKCE flow must use code_verifier/code_challenge; authorization code must not be replayable.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-011.assertion: forall token_exchange(code, verifier): sha256(verifier) == stored_challenge AND code.is_single_use

locations.note: PKCE verified at lines 109-120 via verifyCodeChallenge(). Code is deleted immediately after fetch (line 83: delete_authorization_code RPC) to prevent replay before validation is complete (TOCTOU risk: delete happens before PKCE check).
Enforces code_challenge_method == 'S256' at lines 40-44; code_challenge is required (line 26).
S256 PKCE: sha256(verifier).base64url == challenge. Returns false for any non-S256 method.
